customManagers.description: Track @anthropic-ai/claude-code version pinned in the sidecar Dockerfile ARG and the root Dockerfile's claude-cli build stage (#8145)

packageRules.description: Throttle @anthropic-ai/claude-code and @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk bumps: weekly window + stability delay to avoid yanked releases. The SDK bump moves the `claude` CLI version it is paired with (claudeCodeVersion) — the soft advisory floor claude-sdk warns against, #8031 — so throttling it the same way gives CLI release channels that lag behind `latest` (e.g. npm `stable`) time to catch up before the pairing moves again.
